codeReview.summary: SaleService was successfully refactored to replace syncGroupId with FK references throughout. All business logic (state machine methods: confirm, deliver, finalizeDelivery, cancel; atomic item operations: addItem, updateItem, removeItem; payment recording) was preserved. The service extends BaseService and correctly passes undefined for syncGroupId parameter to queueSync calls, relying on FK references (saleId in payload) for operation ordering.

issues.description: Sale interface still includes syncGroupId: string | null field which is always set to null. This is for backward compatibility with existing data but could be removed in a future cleanup phase.
createDraft returns syncGroupId: null which matches the interface but the field is no longer populated in the database. Consider removing this field entirely in future cleanup.

SaleService extends BaseService instead of the generated SalesService due to type incompatibility (string vs Date timestamps). This was documented and is acceptable for this critical service where business logic preservation takes priority.
